geometryBasis: OpenStreetMap way 42276662 is the 19-vertex main manor footprint south of the farm courtyard. The projection toward the garden and end gables match the museum conservator’s description and the cleared photos.
sectionBasis: Two exact Daderot garden views from September 2009 and the exact Mahlum courtyard view establish the pre-fire siding, two unequal towers, timber bracing, gables and window divisions. Vertical sections and fine details are visual estimates.
